title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E8 — Martha Throws a Tea Party
Martha and her niece Sophie visit their favorite tea shop, Arogya, in Westport, Conn., to discover the dos and don'ts of making tea; they return to Martha's kitchen to create dishes with tea.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E10 — Italian Favorites
Eight-layer pork ragù; béchamel-filled lasagna baked in ramekins; chicken Parmesan; raviolo with an egg yolk and ricotta-spinach filling; linguine with clam sauce.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E11 — On the Bone
Oxtail; slow-roasted beef ribs; cowboy steak; Korean short rib kebabs.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E12 — Cheese
Cheese fondue; fettuccine Alfredo; melting raclette; grown-up grilled cheese.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E13 — Lamb
Butterflied, rolled and roasted leg of lamb; lamb tagine with spiced butternut squash and prunes; yogurt-marinated lamb kebabs; seared loin lamb chops served with mint jelly and fried fingerling potatoes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E3 — Vegetables
Simple vegetable side dishes include steamed spinach, sautéed broccoli rabe, roasted cauliflower steaks, brown sugar-glazed carrots, sautéed sugar snap peas and shelled peas with mint and lemony kale salad.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E6 — Rice
Fluffy white rice; pilaf; risotto; Thai fried rice.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E7 — Dressings and Emulsions
Shallot vinaigrette prepared two different ways; creamy blue cheese dressing; mayonnaise; BLT.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E13 — Muffins and Popovers
Blueberry muffins two ways -- flavored with spice or finished with a crumb topping; airy popovers that can be served with blueberry preserves or creamed spinach.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E1 — Coffee Cakes
Rhubarb upside-down crumb cake; jam-filled coffee cake muffins; streusel cake; glazed lemon-blueberry coffee cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E2 — Shortbread
Shortbread wedges; brown-butter shortbread lemon bars; brown sugar pecan shortbread cookies; pumpkin tart.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E4 — Cookies
Brown sugar chocolate chip cookies; old-fashioned lemon sugar cookies; chewy chocolate ginger-molasses cookies; sable; glazed citrus doodles.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E5 — Custards
Crème caramel; crème brûlée; cherry clafoutis; mocha custards.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E6 — Croissants
Light, crispy croissants; pain au chocolat; ham and cheese minicroissants; pain aux raisins.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E7 — Special Breads
Irish soda bread; olive and cheese loaf; Sally Lunn; custard-filled cornbread.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E1 — Martha's Amazing Maze and How to Grow Trees From Seedlings
Martha's new passion project is the maze she's building on her Bedford farm; she shares her plans and inspiration for the project and teaches the proper measuring, staking and fertilizing techniques to properly plant successful trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E3 — Amazing Houseplants
Martha brings the outdoors inside the home and shares her love of houseplants; she shows how to take care of the most popular houseplants and how to propagate them to create new plants.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E4 — The World of Succulents
Martha explores how to care for succulents including watering, fertilizing, and repotting.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E9 — Martha and the Chocolate Factory
Martha visits Mast Market in Mt. Kisco, N.Y., and learns the art behind making their renowned chocolate; from roasting cacao, to stone grinding, to forming delicious bars and chips.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E2 — India: A Tour of Food
Martha's friend and restaurateur, Shiva Natarajan, shares the key to making any Indian dish - spices; back in Martha's kitchen, they make butter chicken, lemon rice, and a tangy yogurt sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E3 — Magic Mushrooms
Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E4 — Picture Perfect Rolled Lasagna
Restaurant owners Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli join Martha in making their rolled lasagna with San Marzano tomato sauce, Italian bolognese, and chrysanthemum Caesar salad.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E5 — Easy Homemade Dumplings
Martha, Monica Tran Carden, and Andrew Yu make homemade dumplings; Martha and Monica hand-make wontons and pork dumplings; Andrew and Martha prepare jade dumplings and pork and shrimp dumplings.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E6 — The Bagel Show
Martha samples bagel toppings and is joined by Gary Greengrass, owner of Barney Greengrass, an NYC staple; at PopUp Bagels, Martha makes bagels and constructs breakfast sandwiches with Adam Goldberg.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E7 — Martha's Favorite Cakes
Martha makes the classic meringue cake from Casa Cipriani with pastry chef Alessia Tomassetti; Martha and bakery owner Lucie Franc De Ferriere bake a pear raspberry cake with jam and maple buttercream.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E1 — Martha Throws an Argentine Asado BBQ
Martha is throwing a very special BBQ called Asado; plus Martha prepares a chimichurri sauce, her daughter Alexis's chopped salad and for dessert, fruit flavored popsicles; a perfect celebration.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S3 E20 — Chocolate Turnovers; Milk Paint
Chocolate turnovers; milk paint.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S3 E27 — Topiaries; Clematis; Staking Good Thing
Topiaries; staking peonies; clematis.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S3 E28 — Pegging and Pruning Roses; Wreaths; Manure Tea
Living wreaths; manure tea; pegging/pruning roses.
